summary:
Project ARES – Mars Survival is an interactive, browser-based educational quiz game designed to introduce players to the challenges of human survival on Mars.

The game is based on a fictional mission in which three astronauts travel from Earth to Mars to conduct scientific research and explore the Martian environment. During their mission, they face several survival challenges involving oxygen supply, food availability, radiation exposure and other environmental difficulties.

Players must use their scientific knowledge, logical thinking and decision-making skills to answer questions and overcome different survival situations.

Instead of presenting scientific information through traditional learning methods, Project ARES transforms Mars exploration and survival education into an engaging, interactive gaming experience.

Project Objectives :-
The main objectives of Project ARES are:
1. To create awareness about the environmental conditions of Mars.
2. To educate players about the challenges of human survival on Mars.
3. To introduce basic scientific concepts related to space exploration.
4. To improve logical thinking and decision-making through quiz-based challenges.
5. To make space science accessible and enjoyable through browser-based gaming.
6. To encourage interest in future human space exploration.
details:
Problem Statement

Mars is one of the most promising destinations for future human exploration. However, living on Mars presents several significant challenges.

Some of the major challenges include:

  • Oxygen: Mars has an extremely thin atmosphere, which is not suitable for humans to breathe.
  • Food: Astronauts need reliable food supplies and sustainable food production systems.
  • Radiation: Mars lacks the strong global magnetic field and thick atmosphere that protect Earth, leaving its surface exposed to greater radiation risks.
  • Water: Accessing and managing water resources is essential for long-term survival.
  • Environmental Conditions: Extreme temperatures, dust storms and other environmental conditions make exploration difficult.

Our project aims to help people understand these challenges through an interactive educational game.

Mission Story:

Three astronauts travel from Earth to Mars for a long-term scientific research mission. Their objective is to explore the planet, understand its environment and complete their mission while managing critical survival challenges.

Throughout the game, players encounter different situations and must answer quiz questions to make the right decisions.

Main gameplay challenges

Players progress through the mission by answering questions correctly and demonstrating their understanding of Mars.

5. Key Features

  • Browser-Based Gameplay: Players can access the game through a web browser without installing a separate application.
  • Interactive Quiz System: Players answer questions related to Mars, space science and astronaut survival.
  • Mission-Based Learning: The game connects scientific questions with a fictional Mars exploration storyline.
  • Survival-Themed Challenges: Different survival topics create an engaging mission experience.
  • Educational Content: Players learn about Mars and the difficulties of future human exploration.
  • User-Friendly Interface: A simple interface makes the game accessible to beginners and students.

7. Target Audience

Project ARES is designed for:

  • School and college students.
  • Space science enthusiasts.
  • People interested in Mars exploration.
  • Beginners who want to learn about astronomy.
  • Anyone interested in interactive educational games.

8. Innovation and Uniqueness

The uniqueness of Project ARES lies in combining a survival-based storyline with an educational quiz system.

Traditional educational resources generally explain scientific concepts through text, images or videos. Project ARES presents these concepts through a fictional astronaut mission where players actively participate in solving challenges.

The game connects learning with decision-making, allowing players to understand why oxygen, food, water and radiation protection are important for future Mars missions.

9. Expected Impact

Project ARES aims to make space science more interactive and accessible.

Through this game, players can:

  • Develop a basic understanding of the Martian environment.
  • Learn about the challenges astronauts may face during Mars missions.
  • Understand the importance of life-support systems.
  • Develop curiosity about planetary science and space exploration.
  • Experience science-based learning through gameplay.

In the future, the game could be expanded with additional missions, difficulty levels, more scientific challenges, scoring systems and multiplayer features.

10. Conclusion

Project ARES – Mars Survival is more than just a quiz game. It is an educational experience that combines space science, interactive gameplay and a fictional human exploration mission.

By turning the challenges of Mars exploration into engaging quiz-based activities, our project aims to inspire the next generation to learn more about space, science and humanity's future beyond Earth.

Our vision is simple: Learn about Mars. Face its challenges. Experience the mission.

Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI):

We used ChatGPT for storyline generation, Google Gemini for idea generation, and Claude AI for code generation and development assistance. These AI tools helped us transform our ideas into an interactive browser-based game.
